baseline_commit_meaning: The LAST TESTED IMPLEMENTATION: the commit whose tree produced the latest_verification figures. It is deliberately NOT always the commit carrying this file -- when a paid launch is prepared, a grant/provenance commit and an authorization-only commit follow it and neither is separately tested. A reader must be able to tell which commit the suite numbers describe from which commit a pod checks out. Nothing checks this field; it is refreshed by hand whenever the verified tree moves.

canonical_infrastructure: one immutable SessionSpec per session, one runner, no inheritance, no module-global retargeting
the shared pod setup is manifest-driven on BOTH sides: it installs and stages only what a session declares, and names no asset, relay path, destination or digest of its own
RelayInput carries source, destination, digest and mirror; dest=None means only 'the driver stages this'
the Phase-A authorization schema carries no grant; the issuer requires one
full tracebacks for unexpected in-process driver exceptions
plan_session soft_stop_reserves, applied BEFORE the soft stop
the pre-flight rehearsal ignored in both the pod gate and the simulator, with the ignore lists pinned equal
the pod simulator restores exactly and refuses concurrent sweeps
the layout test partitions its references: repo-relative paths must exist, declared host-local roots are checked where present and skipped where absent, and an undeclared absolute path still fails
an active tombstone may not name a declared session staging or mirror destination - checked against the four SessionSpecs, touching no path, so every environment agrees
checkpoint_tombstones.json owns the active-tombstone counts and bytes
autoinit.stage1_device_contract@v1, incl. category 5: a fresh factory on the Stage-1 path either names a device derived from what it meets, or is host-only on purpose
placement asserted by intercepting factory calls (tests/autoinit/factory_placement.py), the dual of the HostCacheTensor split
causal-depth scoring is device-resident; the reference cache falls back to RECOMPUTE, never to the host
the search deadline is real (runtime-only, never hashed) and is checked before each expansion and inside greedy_removal's candidate loop
the driver holds torch to the cgroup CPU grant via apply_cpu_budget()
a session installs every local root verify_frozen_assets.py requires, derived from the verifier and compared against declarations
a production entrypoint is a callable seam, not a main(): all orchestration is one injectable function the $0 test executes
evaluate_teardown separates a truncated stream from an artifact never written; a caller supplying no evidence keeps the strict rule
the Stage-1 runtime deadline is READ OFF the priced envelope (base + every soft-stop reserve), so the deadline cannot drift from the price and a new reserve extends it with no edit
